summary: The CHP was told at 9:56 p.m. about a pedestrian in the northbound lanes of Highway 99 just north of the airport exit, wearing all white.
Medics were sent at 9:56 p.m. to the 500 block of Roberts Lane for a seizure.

Officers were sent at 8:07 p.m. to a home in the 100 block of Hopkins Avenue for a verbal disturbance that included a report about a child, with two men and a woman reported to be involved and a 4-year-old present.
A car fled from an officer east on Pioneer Drive at 9:44 p.m. and was lost a short distance later.
Fire crews were sent at 9:55 p.m. to a mechanic's yard on South Union Avenue between White Lane and Pacheco Road for a fire of unknown origin.

Officers and medics were sent at 10:10 p.m. to the 8300 block of California Avenue for an assault; a man was reported to have hit his head on a wall during an argument with his father and was not moving.
Officers were sent at 10:27 p.m. to the 8500 block of Gila River Drive, where a woman in her early 20s was reported to have thrown her shoes at the caller during an argument.
Officers were sent at 10:31 p.m. to the 500 block of Poinsetta Street for a man reported to be under the influence of marijuana and hallucinating.
Officers were sent at 10:49 p.m. to the 3700 block of Apache Avenue after a woman texted a friend that she was in danger and asked for police, saying she had met an unknown man there.

Deputies were sent at 12:11 a.m. to an armed robbery that had just happened at a gas station on the 21,900 block of Highway 46. Two juvenile suspects in masks, at least one armed, took cash from the register and from a customer, then ran east on foot toward a nearby restaurant.
Fire crews and the CHP were sent at 12:22 a.m. to a vehicle rollover on westbound Highway 58 just west of South H Street that was blocking the fast lane.
A traffic stop on Castro Lane turned into a pursuit at 12:25 a.m. that moved onto Highway 99, where all lanes were cleared for it and the car left south from Highway 58.
Officers were sent at 1:02 a.m. to the 20,400 block of Brian Way for a woman reported to be slumped over the steering wheel of a white Jeep parked at a business.
Fire crews were sent at 1:25 a.m. to the middle field at San Juan Ballpark, 4009 Chester Avenue, for a medical aid.
Officers were sent at 1:54 a.m. to the 100 block of Washington Avenue for a possible overdose after clothing was found on the ground outside a home.
A driver told officers at 1:55 a.m. that a man in a white Honda had brandished a firearm; the caller then stopped answering dispatch.
A wrong-way driver on Highway 99 was spun with a PIT maneuver at 2:06 a.m. but kept going, creeping southbound at only a few miles an hour near Houghton Road.
Officers were told at 2:39 a.m. about two people with flashlights and backpacks walking on a school campus.
Fire crews were sent at 3:08 a.m. to an outside fire in the alley behind 1515 Tulare Street.
Medics were sent at 3:13 a.m. to a unit on Joseph Lane for a cardiac arrest.
Officers and medics were sent at 3:47 a.m. to Gilmore Avenue and Buck Owens Boulevard, where a man was reported to have pepper-sprayed the caller during a dispute over payment.
Fire crews were sent at 4:02 a.m. to a vehicle fire fully involved with no exposures.

Fire crews and the CHP were sent at 4:52 a.m. to the 8,100 block of Old River Road for a single vehicle that rolled onto its roof. The driver was out of the car and the patients refused to be taken to a hospital.
The CHP was told at 5:06 a.m. about a person in dark clothing standing on the shoulder of northbound Highway 99 near the overpass.
Officers were sent at 5:17 a.m. to a business on Brundage Lane for an alarm that showed at the front door.
Medics were sent at 5:27 a.m. to the President's Hotel, 1622 Union Avenue, for several patients reporting a burning sensation.
The CHP was called at 5:42 a.m. to a two-vehicle crash on the westside parkway at Mohawk Street, where the other driver, in a brown Toyota, was last seen north through Rosedale.
Medics were sent at 5:49 a.m. to the 10,800 block of Green Road for difficulty breathing.
Person fell and unconscious near Au Chocolat Drive.
Officer search for suspected drugs and weapons.
Non-injury rollover crash on Woodford/Tehachapi Road.
Pursuit near Center Street ends in field; 1 detained.
CPR in progress on elderly woman near Leland Avenue in Bakersfield.
Alarm activation at business office.
Domestic dispute with death threats at Betty Street home.
Woman reports assault at Elmwood Avenue home.
Welfare check after women seen looking into car.
